environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with a NAT gateway attached to the route table. The SMTP relay (Postfix) runs on an internal EC2 instance at 10.0.1.50:25 with open relay configuration (no authentication, no recipient restrictions). SQS VPC endpoint is configured. The task IAM role has sqs:ReceiveMessage and sqs:DeleteMessage permissions. No email content filtering or DLP inspection on the SMTP relay.

config.network_acl: allow all internal traffic, egress via NAT
